**Job Description**

* Propose hiring solutions for new businesses
* Ensure key targets are met like on\-time delivery, Cost per Hire, Replacement cost etc.
* Promoting low cost channels to deliver maximum requirement like campus, referrals and Direct to talent (Portals; Social Media; Job Fairs; etc.) maintaining quality of hire
* Check on the hiring process and highlight any deviations from the company policy
* Ability to Highlight risk accounts on time with appropriate data points
* Drive team to be compliant and ensure all processes are followed as per audit guidelines
* Ability to map profiles hired to other organizations and quote any challenges/changes needed for hiring those profiles
* Willing to work on weekend drives if required
* Manage and oversee the recruitment process from start to finish
* Collaborate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs and develop recruitment strategies
* Post job openings on various platforms and manage candidate applications
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone interviews to shortlist candidates
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring teams
* Assist in coordinating job offers and onboarding processes for new hires
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment data and reports
* Ensure compliance with all relevant employment laws and regulations
